name: AF Gruppen ASA
summary: AF Gruppen ASA, a contracting and industrial company, provides civil engineering, construction, energy and environment, and property and offshore services in Norway and Sweden. The company provides civil engineering services, including construction of various projects, such as roads, railways, airports, foundation work, building, fitting and securing tunnels, bridges, port facilities, tunnels, renovation and construction of concrete structures, power and energy plants, and onshore facilities for oil and gas; and concrete technology, groundwork and earthmoving, geomatics and surveying, and project support services.
